name: Ricardo Valenzuela
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began in his father's auto repair shop in Valencia. He spent his youth immersed in the world of engines and chassis, developing a deep understanding of vehicle mechanics. After completing his apprenticeship, Ricardo sought to apply his skills to the high-octane world of racing. He started as a junior fabricator for a small touring car team, quickly proving his worth through meticulous attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.

His approach to fabrication is rooted in precision and durability. Ricardo believes that a well-built component can be the difference between victory and disaster. He is known for his relentless pursuit of perfection, often pushing himself and his team to exceed expectations. This demanding nature, coupled with his unwavering commitment, has earned him a reputation as a highly respected and sought-after fabricator within the motorsport community. His current focus is on refining welding techniques to improve chassis rigidity.

Ricardo distinguishes himself through a combination of old-school craftsmanship and innovative thinking. He's equally comfortable wielding a traditional welding torch as he is exploring new materials and fabrication methods. He is driven by a desire to contribute to the team's success, consistently seeking ways to optimize performance and reliability through superior fabrication techniques.
